question.problem:
What is the cube of $10?$

The cube of $10$ is
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
We need to evaluate ${10}^{3}.$

To evaluate ${10}^{3},$ we start by writing it out with multiplication signs:

$$
{10}^{3}={{10\times 10\times 10}_{⏟}}_{3\text{ times}}
$$

Now, we compute the product. Since $10\times 10=100,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{{10\times 10}_{⏟}}_{100}\times 10 & =100\times 10.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, since $100\times 10=1,000,$ we have ${10}^{3}=1,000.$
